risk_note: RV2 (orders/**; money input). Attribution pipeline step ⑥: on the first processing where the order is attributed, platform_status ∈ {PAID, RECEIVED, SETTLED} and rebate_status ∉ {VOID, CLAWED_BACK}, the injected commission port (B2-03g createCommissionSnapshot) is called in the same transaction; N = commission − service fee (BR-CALC-03) computed once in orders with @couli/money in integer fen and passed as nBaseFen (commission does not deduct again); paid_at source falls back platform → platform_modified → observed; missing amounts, service-fee rate or rule version write order_sync_pending with a flat-field warning instead of guessing; no port injected → step skipped (B1-08h / i / j frozen tests unchanged). Automatic retry after pending awaits the orchestrator ruling (D10-68). No rebate_status / hold writes.
